item.title: Idaho fast food restaurant shooting leaves 3 dead and 7 injured, city spokesman says
item.description: A Twin Falls city spokesman says that three people were killed and seven more were injured, some critically, in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho on Saturday afternoon.
